report.verdict: The Registered Nurse, Medical-Surgical Unit (Nights) role is a different track from your Data Analyst work at Carolina Home Goods. Your resume backs up the analytics work, but it doesn't show nursing qualifications. Is this the role you meant to target?
write_up: The nursing posting calls for a clinical background that your resume doesn't show. Your story is data analysis: insurance reporting at Piedmont Insurance Services, followed by sales and merchandising work at Carolina Home Goods. I would pass on this resume for the nursing role, but it makes a strong case for analyst work.

The markdown line is a great model: it names the analysis, the 2,100 SKUs and the merchandising team's adoption of your recommendation. Your experience leads your education, and the progression from Junior Analyst to Data Analyst is easy to follow.

If nursing is the intended direction, the credentials and clinical work listed in the posting need to be present before this resume can make that case. For analyst roles, keep the substance you have and consider moving the automated sales report higher. Your resume presents that work well; how competitive each opening is will matter too.

cards.line: Analyzed markdown timing for 2,100 SKUs; the merchandising team adopted the recommended schedule in two categories
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It connects your analysis to a decision another team made, while keeping your part and theirs distinct.

cards.line: Build and maintain 14 Power BI dashboards used by the sales, merchandising, and finance teams
cards.cannot_tell: For a more senior analyst role, a decision you made about reporting across teams could show how you guide the work beyond maintaining dashboards.
cards.example: Build and maintain 14 Power BI dashboards used by the sales, merchandising, and finance teams, and [what you did to guide reporting across teams]
cards.question: What reporting decision did you make across teams, and what was your part in putting it into practice?

cards.line: Wrote the SQL model that replaced a 3-day manual weekly sales report with an automated one
cards.cannot_tell: Move this above the dashboard line for analyst applications. Replacing a 3-day manual report makes the change you delivered immediately visible.

fit.why: Your headline and both analyst roles center on reporting, data analysis and the tools used to do that work.
fit.level: mid-level, current Data Analyst role following a Junior Analyst role
fit.note: Your reporting and SQL work is well presented for analytics positions; keep a version focused on those roles. The nursing job is on nights with rotating weekends.

posting.summary: A medical-surgical registered nurse role providing bedside care, medication administration, documentation and patient education on a night shift.
missing: Current unrestricted North Carolina RN license or compact state license
BLS certification required; ACLS within six months of hire
Minimum 1 year of acute care nursing experience preferred; new graduates with a strong clinical rotation considered
Experience with Epic or a comparable EHR
Ability to manage a patient assignment of 5 to 6 patients
